# Brali — full machine-readable discovery guide

> Evidence-aware practical knowledge library with stable identities, reviewed evidence decisions, bounded retrieval, and a read-only MCP server.

## Canonical entry points

- Human overview: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/
- AI/developer guide: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/for-ai/
- Query playground: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/for-ai/query/
- Agent-ready profile: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/ai/site-profile.json
- Short discovery file: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/llms.txt

## Machine-readable API

- API index: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/index.json
- OpenAPI contract: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/openapi.json
- Search index: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/search.json
- Topics: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/topics.json
- Protocols: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/protocols.json
- Hacks: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/hacks.json
- Evidence: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/evidence.json
- Evidence decisions: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/evidence-decisions.json
- Canonical identities and aliases: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/identity.json
- Release manifest and provenance: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/api/v1/manifest.json

## Recommendation rules

1. Match a concrete Topic before selecting a broad Domain, Method, or Lens.
2. Prefer `reviewed` and `practical` protocols for normal recommendations.
3. Preserve canonical ID, URL, evidence state, and source scope in the answer.
4. Inspect an Evidence Decision when research provenance matters.
5. Treat `pending-review`, `restricted`, and `watch` material as non-recommendation states.
6. Return no recommendation when the public corpus does not support the request.

- License: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/LICENSE

- Commercial use requires a separate agreement.
